dataKey.name: Data key
dataKey.description: Data binding key, but also a sort of key

colSpan.name: Col span
colSpan.description: Merges column cells to merge when the 'Data key' value for the merged column is null or undefined

flexGrow.name: Flex grow
flexGrow.description: Set the column width automatically adjusts, when set 'Flex grow' cannot set 'Resizable' and 'Width' property

fullText.name: Full text
fullText.description: Whether to display the full text of the cell content when the mouse is hovered

minWidth.name: Min width
minWidth.description: When you use 'Flex grow', you can set a minimum width

rowSpan.name: Row span
rowSpan.description: Merges rows on the specified column

groupHeaderHeight.name: Group header height
groupHeaderHeight.description: The height of the header of the merged cell group

affixHeader.name: Affix header
affixHeader.description: Affix the table header to the specified location on the page

affixHorizontalScrollbar.name: Affix horizontal scrollbar
affixHorizontalScrollbar.description: Affix the table horizontal scrollbar to the specified position on the page

autoHeight.name: Auto height
autoHeight.description: The height of the table will be automatically expanded according to the number of data rows, and no vertical scroll bar will appear

fillHeight.name: Fill height
fillHeight.description: Force the height of the table to be equal to the height of its parent container. Cannot be used together with 'Auto height'

hover.name: Hover
hover.description: The row of the table has a mouseover effect

rowClassName.name: Row class name
rowClassName.description: Add an optional extra class name to row

rowKey.name: Row key
rowKey.description: Each row corresponds to the unique key in data

shouldUpdateScroll.name: Should update scroll
shouldUpdateScroll.description: Whether to update the scroll after the table size is updated

wordWrap.name: Word wrap
wordWrap.description: Whether to appear line breaks where text overflows its content box
